title: Portfolio Diversification and Concentration under Dependence Uncertainty: A Majorization Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.04496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern portfolio theory identifies diversification as the primary tool for risk reduction. However, under model uncertainty, this cornerstone may no longer remain optimal. This paper investigates the tension between portfolio diversification and concentration under dependence uncertainty. In the absence of model uncertainty, we employ the framework of the majorization order and doubly stochastic matrices to formalize the degree of diversification, and prove that quasi-convexity is a necessary and sufficient property for a risk functional to be weakly consistent with the majorization order. We further derive worst-case risk measure inequalities and solve robust portfolio selection problems for a broad class of risk measures, including VaR, ES, Range-VaR (RVaR), and standard deviation (SD). translated_title: 依赖不确定性下的投资组合分散化与集中化：一种优化序方法
translated_abstract: 现代投资组合理论将分散化视为降低风险的首要工具。然而，在模型不确定性之下，这一基石可能不再保持最优。本文研究了依赖不确定性下投资组合分散化与集中化之间的张力。在没有模型不确定性的情况下，我们采用优化序与双随机矩阵的框架来形式化分散化程度，并证明拟凸性是风险函数与优化序弱相一致的充要性质。我们进一步推导了最坏情形风险度量不等式，并针对一大类风险度量（包括在险价值VaR、期望损失ES、区间VaR（RVaR）和标准差（SD））求解了稳健投资组合选择问题。我们的结果揭示了许多被广泛使用的风险函数所存在的“集中悖论”：当依赖结构完全模糊时，稳健优化……
tldr: 本文借助优化序与双随机矩阵形式化投资组合分散化程度，证明拟凸性是风险函数与优化序弱一致的充要条件，并在依赖不确定性下为VaR、ES、RVaR和标准差等广泛使用的风险度量求解了稳健组合选择问题，揭示出“集中悖论”——当依赖结构完全模糊时，稳健最优策略往往偏好集中而非分散。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes portfolio diversification via the majorization order and doubly stochastic matrices, proves quasi-convexity is necessary and sufficient for weak consistency with the majorization order, and solves robust portfolio selection for VaR, ES, RVaR, and SD under dependence uncertainty, revealing a "concentration paradox" whereby fully ambiguous dependence structure makes concentration rather than diversification robustly optimal.
